operation: Publish existing artifacts only; no training, inference or account replay

credential_scan.scope: All selected bytes, decompressed gzip and archive members; local .env credential-value matches plus common token/private-key patterns

known_gaps: No persisted per-stock position/holdings snapshots or order/fill blotters in the three requested run directories
Drawdown batch saves selected daily ledgers, not full daily ledgers for all 915 accounts
Reference-network standalone preprocessing/scaler and graph exports were not saved; source reconstructs them from the reviewed inputs; learned state remains in checkpoints
Raw 15-minute chunks and older parent-run artifacts referenced by legacy provenance locks are not included
